summary.en: Conan enters a Sherlock Holmes contest to win a rare first-edition book and persuades Ran Mouri and Kogoro to attend. Once at the place of the contest, everyone must take a 1000-question test about Sherlock Holmes. Heiji also attends and reveals to Ran that he thought he would meet Shinichi there. Later that day, Hiroyuki Kanaya, the host, is seen driving his car off a cliff and into the ocean. He appeared to had driven the SUV off the cliff, but when Conan and Heiji looked inside the window when the SUV was about to drive off the cliff, they noticed a lot of strange things. Hiroyuki's death is presumed to be a murder and contestant Ayako Oki reveals she knows who the murderer is. Later a garage explosion and fire occurs, after dousing the flames Ayako is found dead. Ayako went to get something in the back of a SUV. The murderer told her to get it. The car then ignited and exploded with her in it. Next, a blackout occurred and Toshiaki Fujisawa, another contestant, is stabbed in the arm with an ice pick due to the timely intervention by Conan and Heiji who realize that the murderer is indeed among them. A fuse breaks and the lights go off. Conan and Heiji barely notice an item (ice pick) about to hit the victim. They dive and knock Toshiaki over so it doesn't kill him but is instead stabbed in the arm.
